g.text: A quarter-bridge turns one strain-gauge resistance change into a differential voltage

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Balance when R₁/R₃=R₂/R₄. With R=120 Ω, GF=2 and ε=1000 µε, ΔR=0.24 Ω. Exact right-minus-left output is +2.4975 mV, linear approximation +2.5000 mV.
Output sensing is assumed high impedance; excitation and lead/temperature compensation affect accuracy.
